

# certmgr.exe is all Rust (certmgr-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/certmgr-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# certmgr.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/certmgr-rust/src/certmgr/certmgr_cpp_h.rs)
# CStoreList.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/certmgr-rust/src/certmgr/CStoreList_cpp_h.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(certmgr_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(certmgr_shims PRIVATE uuid cpprt atl_classes libcryptui libcrypt32 libole32 libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(certmgr_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_dependencies(certmgr_shims psdk)
add_cargo_module(certmgr certmgr-cargo certmgr.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE certmgr-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS certmgr_shims psdk uuid_sources xdk)
